upstreamChangesPreserved.after:
A smaller version of the solemn gold armor that adorns the warhorses of the Tree Sentinels who serve the Erdtree.

One of several liveries once prepared for spectral steeds, which allows Torrent, through grace, to change his appearance.

Though a spectral steed's form will change when vested in this garb, their heart will remain the same.

upstreamChangesPreserved.name: N:\GR\data\INTERROOT_win64\msg\engUS\GoodsCaption.fmg
upstreamChangesPreserved.after:
The richly ornamented white silver armor of the Carian Royal line is a one-of-a-kind item made for a certain spectral steed, once forged in the lands of the Three Sisters.

Though a spectral steed's form will change when vested in this garb, their heart will remain the same.

customOperations.after: "Me?"

customOperations.name: N:\GR\data\INTERROOT_win64\msg\engUS\EventTextForTalk.fmg
customOperations.after: "This tiny golden aura is the grace of the Erdtree."

customOperations.name: N:\GR\data\INTERROOT_win64\msg\engUS\EventTextForTalk.fmg
customOperations.after: "O Radagon, leal hound of the Golden Order."

customOperations.name: N:\GR\data\INTERROOT_win64\msg\engUS\EventTextForTalk.fmg
customOperations.after: "I declare mine intent, to search the depths of the Golden Order."

customOperations.name: N:\GR\data\INTERROOT_win64\msg\engUS\EventTextForTalk.fmg
customOperations.after: "Hark, brave warriors. Hark, my lord Godfrey. We commend your deeds."

customOperations.name: N:\GR\data\INTERROOT_win64\msg\engUS\EventTextForTalk.fmg
customOperations.after: "My Lord, and thy warriors. I divest each of thee of thy grace."

customOperations.name: N:\GR\data\INTERROOT_win64\msg\engUS\EventTextForTalk.fmg
customOperations.after: "Then, after thy death, I will give back what I once claimed."

customOperations.name: N:\GR\data\INTERROOT_win64\msg\engUS\EventTextForTalk.fmg
customOperations.after: "The Erdtree governs all. The choice is thine."

customOperations.name: N:\GR\data\INTERROOT_win64\msg\engUS\EventTextForTalk.fmg
customOperations.after: "Is there...another person inside of you?"

customOperations.name: N:\GR\data\INTERROOT_win64\msg\engUS\EventTextForTalk.fmg
customOperations.after: "Is there...another person inside of you?"

customOperations.name: N:\GR\data\INTERROOT_win64\msg\engUS\EventTextForTalk.fmg
customOperations.after: "Think not, of the kindling."

customOperations.name: N:\GR\data\INTERROOT_win64\msg\engUS\EventTextForTalk.fmg
customOperations.after: "Hear me, Demigods. My children beloved."

customOperations.name: N:\GR\data\INTERROOT_win64\msg\engUS\EventTextForTalk.fmg
customOperations.after: "There is something I'd like to say."

customOperations.name: N:\GR\data\INTERROOT_win64\msg\engUS\EventTextForTalk.fmg
customOperations.after: "If you intend to claim the frenzied flame,"

customOperations.name: N:\GR\data\INTERROOT_win64\msg\engUS\EventTextForTalk.fmg
customOperations.after: "I shall see to the kindling."

customOperations.name: N:\GR\data\INTERROOT_win64\msg\engUS\EventTextForTalk.fmg
customOperations.after: "Please, seek not the frenzied flame."

customOperations.name: N:\GR\data\INTERROOT_win64\msg\engUS\EventTextForTalk.fmg
customOperations.after: "Please, put a stop to this madness."
